observations: A black synthesizer-style electronic keyboard lying on a green artificial-grass backdrop.
Photo 0 and 2 show 'YAMAHA' and 'PortaSound' / 'Professional' branding on the top-left panel, with a partially legible 'PSS-' model code that is too blurred/small to read fully.
Keyboard has roughly 2 octaves of mini/半-size keys, multiple sliders, buttons, and a small LCD-type multi-menu display.
Casing shows visible wear, light scuffing and dust; no close-up of ports, battery compartment, or the adapter itself.
No photo shows the keyboard powered on, any screen lit up, or the adapter plugged in.
No video or audio clip provided to confirm sound output or key response.
Seller's follow-up message is text only, reasserting prior claims, with no new photo or video evidence.

claims.claim: Quality and good Yamaha keyboard for children
claims.evidence: Subjective marketing language; no objective photo evidence of 'quality'.
Seller reasserts in text only; still no video/audio clip showing keys or buttons being pressed and producing sound.
No photo shows an adapter; none of the images include one, and none was sent with the reply.
No proof of purchase, import sticker, or UK plug/voltage marking visible.
Audio-based claim; still unconfirmed from stills; seller's verbal assurance is not visual/audio proof.

claims.claim: "I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true"
claims.evidence: A seller's verbal assurance is not independent evidence; no new photo or clip was provided to support it.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on or may have dead keys/buttons despite claim.
risks.proof: A video clip of the keyboard powering on and each key/button being played with audible sound.

risks.risk: Adapter claimed but not shown; could be missing or wrong voltage/plug for Nigeria.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the adapter with its plug type and voltage rating label.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if adapter not included

risks.risk: Speaker or sound output could be faulty (crackle, distortion) despite claim.
risks.proof: An audio/video clip playing a sustained note or demo tune through the built-in speaker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as speaker/sound unverified, worst case faulty

risks.risk: Model number unreadable, so exact feature set (voices, polyphony, year) is unknown, affecting value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the model plate/label (usually near the power switch or underside).
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic basic Yamaha PortaSound-era keyboard, lowest feature tier

risks.risk: General cosmetic/functional wear from age or import handling not visible in current angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the key surface, hinges, and rear ports/battery compartment.
risks.if_unproven: priced accounting for visible wear only, no bonus for 'like new' condition

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on, each key and button demonstrated with sound.
Clear photo of the model/serial plate (usually on the back or near power switch).
Photo of the adapter showing plug type and voltage rating.
Audio clip confirming no crackle or dead notes across the full key range.
Close-up of ports, battery compartment, and overall rear casing condition.
response.reason: The seller's text reassurance adds no new visual evidence, so the item remains identifiable and priceable by type, but all functional and completeness claims stay unverified and must be priced at worst case until a photo or video substantiates them.
